_about: B-roll effects. One entry per Remotion composition in src/effects/. The panel's B-roll tab builds its form from `fields`, the MCP tools list them, and suggest_broll matches subtitles against `triggers` (regular expressions, case-insensitive). Every effect also takes the common fields x, y, scale, accent, enter, exit (see `common`). `group` is the picker's category. Field types: text, number, bool, color, list, select (one of `options`), image (a picture file's path; the renderer loads it; with "video": true it also takes a video file, which the effect reads as frames).

common.label: In starts at (frame)
common.help: Frame (from the clip start) where the animation In begins; nothing shows before it. The range bar's left head

common.label: Build lands at the In end
common.help: The whole build (count, typing, drawing) finishes at frame delay + enter. The B-roll tab's range bar turns it on

common.label: Lands at (frame)
common.help: 0 = the effect's own pace. Otherwise the frame (from the clip start) where the animation has fully landed; Sync to words sets it to the spoken word

effects.name: Live cursor
effects.description: A named cursor glides in and drags a selection box with handles and a size label around a spot (a face, a product, a word on screen).

fields.label: Box width
fields.help: Share of the frame width

fields.label: Box height
fields.help: Share of the frame height

effects.name: Comment drop
effects.description: A comment box types a word and posts it; the comment drops in, hearts tick up and a reply lands under it. For "comment X" calls to action.

fields.label: Comment
fields.help: {keyword} is replaced with the typed word

fields.label: Reply text
fields.help: Empty = the typed word; e.g. "Sent you the link"

fields.label: Reply button
fields.help: A button under the reply, e.g. "Open link"; empty = none

effects.name: Predict keys
effects.description: A phone keyboard slides up and types the text, with three predictive suggestions changing as it types.

effects.name: Day dial
effects.description: A printed clock dial spins in with a word round its rim and a hand sweeping the hours. For time, days, routines, "every day".

effects.name: Post wall
effects.description: A wall of squares fills in tile by tile while a counter runs up to the number. For "I posted 1,400 times", streaks, consistency.

fields.label: Face 1
fields.help: Optional: tiles become these pictures (up to 4, repeated) instead of colour squares

effects.name: Voice note
effects.description: A chat voice-note bubble pops in, plays (waveform fills, timer runs) with a small caption under it. For quotes, "she told me", calls.
triggers: \b(voice (note|message|memo)|called me|on the phone|(she|he|they) (said|told me)|left me a)\b

effects.name: Sketch words
effects.description: A word is drawn on in pencil: outline first, then hatching fills it, with a scribbled underline and a small handwritten note.

effects.name: Counter
effects.description: A big number counts up with a marker swipe behind it and a label under it: money, followers, subscribers, a multiple ("3x"). Prefix / suffix / decimals set the format.

effects.name: Tag stack
effects.description: Small labelled tags drop one by one and pile up in a wobbly stack (above a head, beside a product). For lists of tools, skills, names. Y is the bottom of the stack.

effects.name: Chapter list
effects.description: An "In this video" side list: numbered items with the current one highlighted and a counter (03 / 20). Reuse it across a video, one clip per chapter.

fields.label: Current item
fields.help: 1 = first item

fields.label: Total shown in counter
fields.help: 0 = number of items

effects.name: Receipt printer
effects.description: A thermal printer feeds a receipt up out of its slot: header, then each line, a whole news line at a time or word by word (with Sync to words each word prints as it is spoken). "Label | value" lines print as two columns. Y is the centre of the printer + paper.

fields.label: Lines
fields.help: One per line. "Label | value" = two columns

fields.label: Word by word
fields.help: Off = a whole line at a time

fields.label: Highlight line
fields.help: 0 = none; 1 = first line (accent bar)

triggers: \b(receipts?|bill|invoice|the cost|costs? (you|me|us)|price (tag|list)|headlines?|breaking|in the news|itemi[sz]ed|line by line|add(s|ed)? up)\b

effects.name: Versus split
effects.description: Two side-by-side cards with a VS or arrow badge (and optional strike-through on the left). For comparisons, "X vs Y", "instead of X, use Y".

effects.name: Stat bar
effects.description: An animated percentage or ratio progress bar with a big readout and label. For "73% of", "9 out of 10", "dropped by 25%".

effects.name: Marker highlight
effects.description: A clean phrase pill where a highlighter swipe (or black redaction bar) sweeps across the focus word.
triggers: \b(the secret is|never do|the truth (is|about)|nobody talks about|don't ever|biggest mistake|hidden|banned)\b

effects.name: Series title
effects.description: A show's official title stamp ("BEFORE 2028": episode kicker with a ballot oval, the show word, the year rolling up, a ruler) and the episode title building under it when it is spoken, its focus line on a marker. Calm, investigative motion with a soft scrim for footage.

fields.label: Show
fields.help: A number at the end rolls up like a counter

fields.label: Focus line
fields.help: On the marker, under the title

fields.label: Title at (s)
fields.help: 0 = 45% into the clip

fields.label: Focus at (s)
fields.help: 0 = just after the title

effects.name: Quote card
effects.description: An editorial quote card or a top notification/alert banner. For quotes, rules of thumb, warnings and reminders.

effects.name: Stamp verdict
effects.description: A claim card with an animated MYTH or FACT stamp that slams onto it. For myth-busting and fact checks.
triggers: \b(myth|a lie|total lie|completely wrong|fact check|stop believing|doesn't work|actually works)\b

effects.name: Year timeline
effects.description: A horizontal date scrubber that rolls to the target year and highlights it. For "in 2019", "since 2020", "5 years ago".

fields.label: Year above caption
fields.help: Two centred rows: the year, then the caption (wraps instead of being cut)

effects.name: Key combo
effects.description: Tactile keycaps that press down in sequence. For keyboard shortcuts and hotkeys.

effects.name: URL bar
effects.description: A browser address pill that types out a domain or link CTA with an open-link button.
triggers: \b(link in bio|go to the website|check the link)\b

effects.name: Ring gauge
effects.description: A circular ring fills to a percentage with a ticking readout in the middle and a label under it. For "9 out of 10", "half of", a share of something.

fields.label: Shown value
fields.help: A plain percentage ticks up; anything else ("9/10") is shown as typed

effects.name: Mini chart
effects.description: A small chart that draws itself: bars growing one after another, or a line drawing left to right behind a leading dot, with the value over each point. For a trend with two or more numbers.

fields.label: Points
fields.help: One per line: "Label | value"

effects.name: Audio pulse
effects.description: Bars, a ring or a glowing orb that move with the voice. Moves on a speech-like stand-in rhythm unless the clip's loudness is passed in (props._samples, one value per frame).

fields.label: Audio track
fields.help: Which sound drives it. 0 = the dialogue (the lowest audio track with sound under the clip)

effects.name: Sticker pop
effects.description: An emoji / icon sticker with a white die-cut edge pops in with a bounce and a slight tilt, with an optional pill label. Punctuates a concept: idea, money, warning, rocket, fire.

fields.label: Own emoji
fields.help: Any emoji here replaces the sticker above

effects.name: Step badge
effects.description: Numbered structure for advice: a quiet "Step 1 of 4" pill with progress dots (step), a big number in a sweeping ring with the point beside it (countdown), or numbered items sliding in one after another (list).

fields.label: Number
fields.help: The current step / item

fields.label: Out of
fields.help: 0 = no "of N"

fields.label: List items
fields.help: List style: the first `Number` items are shown

fields.label: Word
fields.help: Step, Tip, Part, Rule…

fields.label: Number above text
fields.help: Countdown style: the number on top, the text centred under it

effects.name: Lower third
effects.description: A speaker name with a role tag sliding in behind an accent bar (speaker), or a compact "Source: …" pill for a cited stat or claim (source).

effects.name: News ticker
effects.description: A red breaking-news bar across the frame with a pulsing badge, the headline, and a ticker line scrolling under it.

effects.name: Pull quote
effects.description: The frame dims softly and one memorable line is set large in editorial serif type, word by word, with its attribution. Full frame (the Quote card is the compact one).

fields.label: Backdrop
fields.help: How dark the frame gets behind the quote

triggers: \b(remember this|never forget|write this down|here('?s| is) the thing|the truth is)\b

effects.name: Doodle callout
effects.description: A hand-drawn mark draws itself over the footage: circle, box, brackets, arrow, connector between two points, underline, double underline, scribble highlight, star, burst lines or an exclamation mark, with an optional handwritten label. Sized in shares of the frame to fit a face, a chart or a word.

fields.label: Width
fields.help: Share of the frame width

fields.label: Height
fields.help: Share of the frame height

fields.label: Arrow to X
fields.help: Arrow / connector: where it points (X and Y above are where it starts)

effects.name: Doodle icon
effects.description: A simple icon (lightbulb, house, coin, heart, clock, brain…) draws on in outline, then a colour wash or pencil hatching fills it in. For a noun or a metaphor as it is said: idea, money, time, home.

effects.name: Doodle boil
effects.description: Chalk scribbles (white, yellow, pink, blue) loop around the speaker with small rings and sparkles; every line is re-drawn every few frames so it boils. The oval is set by hand: X / Y and the width and height.

fields.label: Follow the speaker's outline
fields.help: The lines trace the speaker's own outline, read from the footage under the clip (the Spotlight cut-out engine). Off, or without it: the oval below

fields.label: Oval width
fields.help: Share of the frame width

fields.label: Oval height
fields.help: Share of the frame height

effects.name: Journal note
effects.description: A taped, lined notebook page where the lines appear as if written by hand (page), or the words alone writing themselves left to right in a script or marker hand (reveal). For reflections, lessons and key takeaways.
triggers: \b(lessons? i('ve| have)? learned|note to self|dear diary|journal(ing)?|i wish i knew)\b

effects.name: Cutout pop
effects.description: A photo slaps into the frame with a slight rotation and a bounce, as if tossed onto a table. With the torn border it gets an uneven white paper edge and a soft shadow (best on a PNG with the background removed).

fields.label: Picture
fields.help: file = the photo below. speaker = the speaker cut out of the footage at the clip's first frame (needs the Spotlight cut-out engine)

fields.label: Remove the photo's background
fields.help: Cuts the person out of the chosen photo with the Spotlight cut-out engine

fields.label: Photo
fields.help: Path to a picture on this computer (PNG / JPG / WebP). A PNG with the background removed gives a real cut-out

effects.name: Paper frame
effects.description: Scrapbook paper around a photo: a taped polaroid with a handwritten caption, a yellowed newspaper clipping with a halftone photo and serif headline, or three paper layers drifting at different speeds for 2.5D depth (parallax).

fields.label: Photo
fields.help: Path to a picture on this computer (PNG / JPG / WebP). A PNG with the background removed gives a real cut-out

effects.name: Cutout puppet
effects.description: A jointed paper cartoon figure with a white cut edge. Its mouth opens and its head and arms bob with the voice (a stand-in rhythm unless props._samples is passed), or it waves, points or cheers. Optional speech bubble.

fields.label: Audio track
fields.help: Which sound drives it. 0 = the dialogue (the lowest audio track with sound under the clip)

effects.name: Ransom text
effects.description: Every letter (or word) is its own cut-out with a random font, angle and paper swatch, as if snipped from different magazines, slapped down one after another.

fields.label: Shuffle
fields.help: Another number = another mix of fonts and swatches

effects.name: Headline wall
effects.description: Torn newspaper clippings and sticky notes pop in around the edges of the frame like a collage, leaving the middle (the speaker) clear.

fields.label: Spread
fields.help: How far from the middle the pieces sit

triggers: \b(headlines?|all over the news|everyone('s| is) talking about|in the news|the media)\b

effects.name: Zoom-through cut
effects.description: A transition: the headline rushes at the camera with radial streaks and a yellow glow until it fills the frame, flashes, and clears. Put the flash on the cut so it hides the change of shot.

effects.name: Phone mockup
effects.description: A phone floats in beside the speaker with a web page inside; the page scrolls fast with motion blur and settles on a readable screen. A screenshot can be the page.

fields.label: Page text
default: A short readable line of the article goes here.

fields.label: Screenshot
fields.help: A screenshot to show as the page instead (a path on this computer)

effects.name: Viewfinder zoom
effects.description: A camcorder HUD over the frame: corner brackets, a blinking REC dot, a running timecode, a ruler and a zoom readout that ticks up. The push-in itself goes on the footage (Effect presets > Transform).

fields.label: Push in on the footage
fields.help: The overlay carries the footage itself, punched in by the zoom shown (reads every frame under the clip: up to 30 s)

effects.name: UI world
effects.description: Glass interface panels float around the speaker: a prompt box typing a request, a progress bar that runs to 100% and ticks, a timeline strip and a small live-preview card. The middle stays clear.

effects.name: Sticky text
effects.description: A sticker-style label slaps onto an object in the shot with a slight tilt and a small wobble, and sticks to it when the shot moves (the spot under the label is tracked through the clip). " | " starts a new line.

fields.label: Stick to the shot
fields.help: Tracks the spot under the label from the frame it lands on, so it moves with the camera or the object (reads the footage under the clip, up to 30 s). Off = it stays where it is put

effects.name: Before + after
effects.description: A bright vertical divider sweeps across the frame with "before" / "after" labels. With a footage look the "before" side is the clip's own frames made flat, washed out or black and white, and the "after" side is the real clip with its grade: two real looks side by side. Tint = only a colour tint over the clip.

fields.label: Before look
fields.help: What the "before" side shows: the clip's own frames with this look (reads the footage under the clip, up to 30 s), or Tint (only a colour over the "after" side)

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Tint look only

fields.label: Sweep from
fields.help: Share of the frame width

fields.label: Tint the right side
fields.help: The tinted side is the "after" side: left by default (the divider reveals it as it sweeps right)

effects.name: Pull-back reveal
effects.description: The frame turns out to be the viewer of a video editor: its panels (an effects checklist ticking off, a timeline with coloured clips and a waveform) pull back into view around a see-through viewer window. Shrink the footage into the window with Effect presets > Transform.

fields.label: Footage inside the viewer
fields.help: The clip's own frames are shrunk into the viewer window (reads every frame under the clip: up to 30 s). Off = a see-through window

fields.label: Viewer size
fields.help: Share of the frame width; X / Y are its centre

effects.name: Wall of videos
effects.description: The frame fills with a grid of vertical video thumbnails while a big counter pops in over it, then the grid fades away. For scale and social proof.

fields.label: Use this timeline's clips
fields.help: The thumbnails are frames of the clips on the timeline; off = coloured placeholders

effects.name: Notification stack
effects.description: Notifications drop in one after another, newest on top, then pile into one card with a ×N badge. For reminders piling up, messages, tasks coming in, being pulled in every direction.

fields.label: App letter
fields.help: The letter in the icon; empty = each line's first letter

fields.label: Notifications
default: Brief #3 | Call me if anything goes wrong
fields.help: One per line: Title | text

effects.name: Checklist card
effects.description: A titled list whose boxes tick themselves one by one, with a done / total counter. For tasks done, a routine, what to prepare, what happened while away.

fields.label: Ticked
fields.help: How many boxes get ticked; -1 = all

effects.name: Avatar split
effects.description: One bubble ("You") splits into a team: avatar bubbles fly out on dotted lines, each with its name. For delegation, a team, sharing the work, who does what.

fields.label: All the way round
fields.help: Off = a fan under the centre bubble

effects.name: Timeline arc
effects.description: An arc is drawn through its points (years with a short note), each popping as the line reaches it, with an optional photo card over the first three. For a journey over several years, then / now / next.

fields.label: Points
fields.help: One per line: Year | note

fields.label: Highlighted point
fields.help: 0 = the last one

fields.label: Photo 1
fields.help: A picture over the first point (a path on this computer)

effects.name: Paper cut
effects.description: The speaker gets a white torn-paper edge and is laid on a sheet of grid paper taped to a dark backdrop, with a ransom-note label. The speaker keeps moving inside the cut-out. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

effects.name: Depth scatter
effects.description: A giant word sits behind and in front of the speaker; its letters fly apart at different depths, the near ones blurred. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

fields.label: Share in front
fields.help: How many of the letters pass in front of the speaker

fields.label: Holds together
fields.help: Share of the clip before the letters fly

effects.name: Orbit
effects.description: Vertical video cards turn round the speaker like a carousel, passing behind and in front, blurred while they move. The cards show frames of the timeline's own clips. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Share of the frame width

fields.label: Turns
fields.help: How far round it goes over the clip; negative = the other way

fields.label: Tilt
fields.help: Near cards sit lower (or higher) than far ones

effects.name: Frame break
effects.description: The video shrinks into a social post card (username, Follow, heart / comment / share, caption) on a dark backdrop with flying debris, and the speaker's head breaks out over the card's top edge. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

fields.label: Head over the edge
fields.help: How far under the top of the head the card's edge sits (share of the frame height)

effects.name: Vertigo
effects.description: A dolly-zoom: the room stretches behind the speaker (or the speaker grows against it) while the room shifts to a cooler tint. The room is the footage with the speaker filled in from around them, so no halo shows behind the cut-out. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

fields.label: What moves
fields.help: Room grows: the real dolly zoom, the speaker stays put and the room stretches behind them. Speaker grows: the speaker swells against the room

fields.label: Room shrinks
fields.help: Room grows only: the room starts stretched and falls back behind the speaker

fields.label: Amount
fields.help: How much the room (or the speaker) grows against the other

fields.label: Room push
fields.help: Speaker grows only: the room moves in this much too

effects.name: Green screen
effects.description: The speaker is cut out of the room and put in front of another picture or video (or a lit stage when none is chosen); the bottom of the frame fades into darkness. Reads every frame of the footage under the clip and cuts the speaker out with the Spotlight engine: up to 20 s, about 0.15 s a frame the first time (cached after).

fields.label: Backdrop
fields.help: A picture or a video on this computer to stand behind the speaker (a video plays from its start and loops); empty = a lit stage in the colours below
